blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Benedicto College (BC) Baby Cheetahs snapped their back-to-back losing skid with an emphatic 70-50 win over the San Roque College de Cebu (SRCDC) Greyhounds in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 high school basketball tournament on Tuesday, September 15, at the Cebu Coliseum. The wire-to-wire win earned the Baby Cheetahs of head coach Gerald Ylaya their first victory of the season, after starting with two successive losses. Jake David Guangco top-scored for Benedicto with 13 points, five rebounds, one steal, and four assists. Rajnish Butaslac added 10 points with four boards, two assists, and five […]...
